name: adlc
description: Agentic Development Life Cycle harness. A persistent Markdown wiki as the knowledge substrate (Karpathy LLM-wiki pattern, OKF-aligned; Obsidian-flavoured, read in Obsidian or wiki-renderer), optional code navigation (a graphify code graph, the Semble and Serena MCP servers, or the JetBrains IDE's MCP server), an optional design worker (impeccable, taste-skill, a design-system folder), an optional one-repository layout with a git worktree per service, an optional engineering method (ub-mode with crapper, dryer and mutator), an optional cost plugin (TokenEconomizer), an AI-tells writing check, role skills for BA / product / architecture work, a plan-driven delivery loop that dispatches build / test / review / verify workers story by story, and the operating model around the loop: a PRD and product domains, epics, sprints and releases with plugin-owned story frontmatter, a generated team board, four decision levels, spikes, gates as decision lines, and a route for every kind of work that is not a story. The vault's Toolset block picks the tools; AGENTS.md project profiling calibrates the harness to each repo. Formerly claude-mem.
